description: Road Closings is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Road, sidewalk, parking and other location-relevant municipal events (noise permits, and more). This information is published by Bloomington's inRoads application on the web, to email lists (public, businesses and press), and through multiple open data formats. Data may also include roads events originating from non-Bloomington sources such as Indiana University, Monroe County Government and INDOT. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Bloomington. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
